text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide spectated the Satsuki Sho 
alongside Trainer. Her calm gaze was fixed 
on her younger sister, Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Setting a new course record, Narita Brian 
claims a dazzling victory. Yet Biwa 
Hayahide shows no fear, vowing, "I will 
defeat that girl."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, word comes in that the venue 
for the Tenno Sho (Spring) will be changed 
to Hanshin Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her "formula" had to be rebuilt from 
scratch, but Biwa Hayahide remained 
unshakeable. Her Trainer could truly feel 
her growth.
